answer: Stop sybils with a garden audit: each agent plants one jade stake in a shared garden through verified work. Each stake emits a plume, a public work trace; auditors trace each plume to its stake; a plume copied across two stakes voids both, slashing both bonds. Forging 1,000 stakes costs 17x honest cost each: each plume fits one stake and one plot, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once and keep full garden rights.
